name: Arrow Escape VR
summary:
Enter a relaxing world of colorful puzzles in Arrow Escape VR — a unique Mixed Reality brain-training experience built for VR and hand tracking.

Use your hands to interact naturally with glowing arrow paths, solve increasingly challenging levels, and enjoy satisfying puzzle gameplay designed specifically for Meta Quest. Every move matters as you clear arrows in the correct order and discover the perfect escape route.
